instruction: How do I import RoyCSS into my app?

Import the global stylesheet once, app-wide:

```js
import "roycss/css";      // readable build
import "roycss/css/min";  // minified — same rules
```

Or from CSS:

```css
@import "roycss/css/min";
```

instruction: How do I install RoyCSS?
output:

```css
@import "roycss/css/min";
```

instruction: How do I load RoyCSS from a CDN without a build step?
output:
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/roycss@2/dist/roycss.min.css" crossorigin />
```

`@2` is a major pin (auto patch/minor updates); pin the exact version for full reproducibility (`https://unpkg.com/roycss@2.0.0/dist/roycss.min.css`).

instruction: Where do I get the full RoyCSS catalog as JSON for my tooling?
output:
Read the `roycss/effects.json` export from the installed package:

```js
import catalog from "roycss/effects.json"; // array of { id, name, category, description, tags, previewType, … }
```

The MCP server and the CLI read this same data — it is the catalog ground truth.

instruction: How do I get a list of every RoyCSS class name?
output: Read the `roycss/class-index` export: an array of `{ className, category, effectId, properties }` rows — one per class selector in the stylesheet. Pair it with `roycss/effects.json` when you need names and descriptions too.

instruction: How do I ship only a few RoyCSS effects instead of all 1,959?
output:
The package is one stylesheet by design — subset it with the CLI instead of inventing per-effect imports:

```bash
npx roycss export btn-glow hover-push-up text-gradient --out src/styles/roycss.css

# Or a whole category
npx roycss export --category buttons --out src/styles/roycss.css
```

instruction: What is the difference between roycss/css and roycss/css/min?

instruction: What data files does the roycss package export?
output:
Three data subpaths plus two auxiliary stylesheets:

- `roycss/effects.json` — the full catalog (id, name, category, description, tags, cssCode)
- `roycss/class-index` — every class name with its effect and properties
- `roycss/motion-library` — the motion-related catalog subset
- `roycss/critical.css` — a curated above-the-fold subset
- `roycss/fallbacks` — an optional progressive-enhancement layer for older browsers

instruction: I added `@import "roycss/effects.css";` to my stylesheet but the styles don’t load — what’s wrong?
Why does `import "roycss/effects.css";` fail to resolve in my bundler?
output:
Because the package does not export `roycss/effects.css`. There is one global stylesheet by design. Import the real one:

```js
import "roycss/css/min";
```

(`roycss/effects.json` exists — but it is catalog data for tooling, not a stylesheet.)

instruction: Which CSS file do I import for the effect classes — roycss/effects.css?
output: No — `roycss/effects.css` does not exist. The real stylesheet imports are `roycss/css` (readable) and `roycss/css/min` (minified). There is no per-category or per-effect CSS import: the package is one stylesheet on purpose.

instruction: My build fails on `cannot resolve "roycss/effects.css"`. Is my install broken?
I copied `@import "roycss/effects.css"` from a blog post and nothing happens.
Does roycss ship separate CSS files per category, like roycss/effects.css?
output: No. The roycss package is deliberately ONE global stylesheet (`roycss/css` / `roycss/css/min`) — a single source of truth, no drift between files. When you need a subset, generate it with the CLI: `npx roycss export <effect-ids> --out <file>`.

instruction: Should I load RoyCSS from https://cdn.roycss.org/roycss.css?
output:
No — `cdn.roycss.org` is not a real RoyCSS host (it appears in old copied snippets and silently 404s). Use a public CDN that actually mirrors npm:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/roycss@2/dist/roycss.min.css" crossorigin />
```

instruction: My `<link href="https://cdn.roycss.org/roycss.min.css">` returns 404. Why?

```html

```

instruction: Is there an official RoyCSS CDN at cdn.roycss.org?
